title: FIX: vision command testing - comprehensive testing guide
description:
Implement vision command integration with comprehensive dogfooding:

DOGFOODING EXERCISE (End-to-End CLI Boundary Testing):
───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
These tests are DOGFOODING EXERCISES - they test the system from OUTSIDE IN through the actual CLI boundary, not internal implementation details. This follows Dave Farley's functional core / imperative shell principle and Martin Fowler's end-to-end testing philosophy.

EARS FORMAT TESTING:
- Vision scenarios with EARS-based behaviors
- Vision responses following EARS patterns
- Vision critiques using EARS format
- Vision sessions storing EARS-based data
Expected: Vision accepts EARS input, validates properly

EDGE CASES:
- Empty vision (no scenarios)
- Malformed vision input
- Invalid personas (not recognized)
- Missing required vision fields
- Invalid vision session IDs
- Corrupted vision session data
Expected: Appropriate error codes, clear error messages

INTEGRATION TESTING:
- Vision session creation (vision start)
- Vision → shape phase transition
- Vision session storage (.interview/vision/)
- Vision session retrieval (vision check, vision critique)
- Cross-phase data sharing (vision → shape → ready)
Expected: Clean session lifecycle, data persistence across phases

END-TO-END TESTING:
- Full workflow: vision start → shape start → shape critique → shape agree
- Vision session management: Create, check, critique, respond, agree
- Phase transitions: vision → shape → ready
- Session persistence: .interview/ directory, session IDs
- Error recovery: Invalid vision, missing spec, permission errors
Expected: Complete vision workflow executes successfully

TEST COMMANDS:
- gleam run -- vision start spec.cue && echo "Pass: vision created"
- gleam run -- vision check <session-id> && echo "Pass: vision retrieved"
- gleam run -- vision critique <session-id> && echo "Pass: vision critiqued"
- gleam run -- vision respond <session-id> && echo "Pass: vision updated"
- gleam run -- vision agree <session-id> && echo "Pass: vision completed"
- ls .interview/vision/ && echo "Pass: sessions created"

VALIDATION:
- Exit codes: 0=success, 1=error, 3=invalid, 4=error
- JSON structure: success, action, command, data, errors, next_actions
- Session files created in .interview/vision/
- Phase transitions work correctly
- Vision data persists across shape → ready

NOT unit tests of:
- Internal vision session functions
- Vision storage functions
- Phase transition logic

Implementation Required:
1. Add 5 glint command wrappers to vision_commands.gleam
2. Add imports: gleam/json, glint, glint/flag, ffi, json_output
3. Register commands in intent.gleam (lines 182-186)
4. Reference pattern: ready_commands.gleam:36-200+
